# Privacy Policy for PDF Tools

**Last Updated:** June 2026

## Introduction

PDF Tools ("the App", "we", "our", or "us") is designed to help users create, edit, manage, and verify PDF documents while prioritizing user privacy and local data processing.

This Privacy Policy explains how PDF Tools collects, uses, stores, and protects information when you use the application on Android, iOS, and macOS devices.

By using PDF Tools, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

---

# Information We Collect

## Information Stored Locally on Your Device

PDF Tools is designed as a local-first application. Most data remains stored on your device and is not transmitted to our servers.

Depending on the features you use, the app may store:

* PDF documents you import or generate
* Scanned documents
* Images created from PDF files
* ZIP files generated by the app
* Recent file history
* Proof records and associated metadata
* Digital signatures
* Company logos and branding assets
* App preferences and settings
* Onboarding and privacy-policy acceptance status

This information is stored locally using device storage and SQLite databases.

---

## Analytics Information

PDF Tools may use Firebase Analytics to collect limited usage information, such as:

* App launches
* Feature usage
* Screen views
* App performance metrics
* Crash diagnostics

Analytics data is used solely to improve app functionality, stability, and user experience.

Analytics information does not include the contents of your PDF files, signatures, proof records, or other document data.

---

## Purchase Information

For Android and iOS, PDF Tools uses RevenueCat and the respective app store billing systems to manage subscriptions and purchases.

When purchases are made:

* Payment information is processed by Apple App Store or Google Play Store.
* We do not receive or store your credit card information.
* RevenueCat may process subscription status and purchase identifiers to manage premium access.

Please review the privacy policies of Apple, Google, and RevenueCat for additional information.

---

# Permissions We Request

Depending on platform and features used, PDF Tools may request the following permissions:

## Camera Permission

Used to:

* Scan documents
* Capture images for PDF creation

The camera is only accessed when you choose to use scanning or image-capture features.

---

## Photo and File Access

Used to:

* Import PDFs
* Import images
* Save generated documents
* Export files

Access is limited to files you choose to open or save.

---

## Location Permission

Location access may be requested when creating proof records that include geographic metadata.

Location information is only collected when you explicitly use features that require it.

---

# How We Use Information

Information collected or stored by the app is used to:

* Create and manage PDF documents
* Generate proof records
* Verify file integrity
* Save user preferences
* Maintain recent file history
* Provide premium features
* Improve app performance and reliability
* Analyze feature usage trends

We do not use your files for advertising purposes.

---

# Data Sharing

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information.

Your PDF files, proof records, signatures, logos, and generated documents remain on your device unless you explicitly export, share, or upload them using services outside the app.

We may share limited information with trusted third-party service providers that support app functionality, including:

* Firebase Analytics
* Firebase Crash Reporting (if enabled)
* RevenueCat
* Apple App Store
* Google Play Store

These providers process data according to their own privacy policies.

---

# Data Retention

Because PDF Tools is a local-first application:

* User-generated documents remain on your device until deleted by you.
* Signatures and logos remain stored locally until removed.
* Recent file records remain available until cleared by the user or app.
* Analytics providers may retain aggregated usage data according to their policies.

---

# Security

We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information handled by the app.

However, no method of electronic storage or transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Users are responsible for maintaining the security of their devices and any files exported or shared outside the app.

---

# Children's Privacy

PDF Tools is not directed toward children under the age of 13.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

If you believe a child has provided personal information through the app, please contact us so appropriate action can be taken.

---

# International Users

PDF Tools may be used worldwide.

Where analytics or purchase-related services are utilized, data may be processed in countries where those service providers operate.

---

# Your Rights

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights regarding personal information, including:

* Access to information about data processing
* Request deletion of information under applicable laws
* Withdraw consent for analytics where supported
* Control permissions through your device settings

Because most app data is stored locally, users generally retain direct control over their information.

---

# Third-Party Services

PDF Tools may rely on third-party services, including:

* Firebase Analytics
* Firebase Core
* RevenueCat
* Apple App Store
* Google Play Store

Use of these services is governed by their respective privacy policies.

---

# Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.

Updated versions will be posted within the application and/or associated app store listings.

The "Last Updated" date will reflect the most recent revision.

---

# Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or the privacy practices of PDF Tools, please contact:

**Email:** [support@yourdomain.com](mailto:support@yourdomain.com)

Replace this email address with your official support contact before publishing.
